body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Creative showcased 'ZiiSound D5', its digital wireless music station for iPhone and iPod during Showstoppers at CES 2010.
A dongle attached to the iPod connector and audio will be transmitted to the dock via Bluetooth.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
